semantic.justification: TaskFKYDT8 ports ScTabView SelectNextTab and SetTabNo sheet grouping from tabview3.cxx and SelectAllTables/DeselectAllTables from tabview2.cxx over real ScViewData/ScMarkData. Native WrapNextPrevSheetTab defaults true. Existing per-sheet cursor state survives navigation;normal selection retains a partial group on already-selected target sheets and collapses an all-selected group. Native Sfx slots26543,26544,26561,26562,26361,26365 use original operation/state boundaries. Navigation commits the real input draft first and rejected drafts prevent movement. Source group-only commands do not change model generation,dirty state or history. Shared CommandMenuBar executes real slots and browser Ctrl/Meta+PageUp/PageDown plus tab-arrow navigation use the same dispatcher. Hidden/alternate sheets,reference editing,drawing/window services and full native parity remain unported. TaskZXWXQ8 connects original no-argument SelectRow/SelectColumn slots26548/26547 to normal-grid ScTabView MarkRows/MarkColumns over actual ScViewData/ScMarkData. Existing simple selection endpoints expand to full axis extents;unmarked selection uses current normal cursor. Cursor and selected sheets remain;selection alone changes neither cells,dirty state nor history. Existing browser input owner commits or rejects pending drafts before selection and publishes real changes. Original ShiftSpace selects rows;column selection uses CtrlSpace on nonMac and AltSpace on Mac,only from the actual grid,not nested editors,composition or modal input. Actual shared Writer menus/resources/dispatch remain reused. Native reference-mode,end-block/window callbacks,parameterized Col/Row/Modifier automation and full native UI/core parity remain unverified. TaskZXWXQ8 also projects the original InitBlockMode start to the existing browser anchor independently of the active cell,so subsequent shift extension uses the selected axis origin. No additional model or native window service is fabricated.
